title: Haas Spieker Undergraduate Business Program — application (continuing students)
eligibility: UC Berkeley sophomores and juniors (apply once)
benefit: Admission to the business major
description: Application opens March 1, 2027 at noon and closes March 31, 2027 at 4:00 pm PT. Prerequisites must be complete by May 14, 2027.

title: Amgen Scholars Program at Berkeley — summer 2027 research
eligibility: Undergraduates in biology / chemistry / biomedical fields (see eligibility on site)
benefit: Paid 10-week summer research (June 7 – August 13, 2027), housing, symposium
description: Online application opens in November; supporting documents due February 1, 2027. Program runs June 7 – August 13, 2027.

title: Cal Hacks 13.0
eligibility: Undergraduate and graduate students from any university
benefit: 36-hour hackathon at the Palace of Fine Arts, San Francisco; travel stipends for some regions
description: October 23–25, 2026. Hacker applications closed September 20; only confirmed hackers can enter. Watch for the next cycle in spring.

title: Berkeley SkyDeck Accelerator — Batch 24
eligibility: Startups with a Berkeley connection (students, alumni, faculty)
benefit: $210K investment for Cohort teams, 6-month program, 900+ advisors
description: Applications for Batch 24 open in January 2027 (exact deadline not yet posted — last batch accepted applications July 20 – August 21). Check the site in January.

title: Big Ideas Contest — pre-proposal round (fall)
eligibility: UC Berkeley undergraduates and graduate students; teams welcome
benefit: Up to $10K+ prizes and mentorship for social-impact innovations
description: Two rounds: a 3-page pre-proposal in the fall (last cycle closed December 2) and an 8-page full proposal in the spring (April). The 2026–27 dates were not yet posted when this was written — confirm on the site.

title: URAP — Undergraduate Research Apprentice Program (Spring 2027)
eligibility: Matriculated UC Berkeley undergraduates
benefit: Work with faculty on research for units; hundreds of projects each semester
description: Fall 2026 applications are closed. The Spring 2027 round is expected to open in early January with a deadline about a week later — the exact date was not yet posted. Browse current projects on the site to prepare.

title: SURF L&S — Summer Undergraduate Research Fellowship 2027
eligibility: L&S undergraduates graduating no earlier than Summer 2027
benefit: Summer research stipend for an independent project with a faculty mentor
description: The 2026 round closed March 13 at noon; the 2027 deadline was not yet posted (expect mid-March). Attend a draft workshop or meet a SURF mentor before applying — it is required.

title: Berkeley Study Abroad — Summer 2027 & Global Internships
eligibility: UC Berkeley undergraduates
benefit: Study, intern or research abroad for Berkeley credit
description: Deadlines vary by program and can be 9–12 months before departure. Use the program finder to see each program's deadline; Summer 2027 Global Internships info sessions are running now.

title: Cal Alumni Association — Leadership Award & Achievement Award
eligibility: Current undergraduates (Leadership Award: innovative leadership; Achievement Award: community-minded students)
benefit: Scholarship funding plus alumni mentoring and community
description: Application dates for the 2027–28 awards were not yet posted. Check the awards page — the Leadership Award cycle usually opens in winter.

title: Prestigious scholarships — Rhodes / Marshall / Fulbright / Gates campus process
eligibility: Juniors, seniors and recent grads (varies by award)
benefit: Fully funded graduate study or research abroad
description: Each award has a campus deadline that comes before the national one. Fall info sessions are running now (Durham, Imperial/UCL/King's, Cambridge presentations). Check the office calendar for the campus deadline of each award.

title: Berkeley Career Engagement — Career Fairs (Engineering & Tech,  STEM,  all-majors)
eligibility: Current UC Berkeley students (Extension students not permitted)
benefit: Meet recruiters; registration required for Engineering & Tech and STEM fairs
description: Fair dates and registration are posted on Handshake. Registration for virtual fairs opens one week before each fair. See the career fair calendar for the current semester.

title: Berkeley Summer Sessions 2027 — enrollment
eligibility: All students
benefit: Catch up or get ahead on units over the summer (Sessions A–F)
description: 2027 session dates and application deadlines were not yet posted; the 2026 deadlines are on the site for reference. Berkeley students enroll via CalCentral.

title: URAP Spring 2027 research apprenticeships
host: UC Berkeley Office of Undergraduate Research & Scholarships (OURS)
eligibility: Matriculated UC Berkeley undergraduates in any college/class level with a UC Berkeley GPA of at least 2.8; concurrent enrollment and study-abroad students not eligible
benefit: Unpaid; 1 unit of UGIS 192 credit per 3 hours/week of research (max 4 units per term)
description: Apprentice with a faculty member or research staff on a semester-long project in any discipline. OURS says new Spring 2027 project listings are posted in late fall; deadline TBA (the URAP FAQ says the deadline is usually Monday of the second week of classes).

title: Mellon Mays Undergraduate Fellowship (MMUF)
host: UC Berkeley Division of Arts & Humanities
eligibility: UC Berkeley second-semester sophomores (or 4+ semesters remaining) with GPA of about 3.4+; U.S. citizens/permanent residents, undocumented or DACA students may apply; interest in a PhD in a Mellon-designated humanities or humanistic social science field
benefit: Program commits to funding Fellows for two years (amount not stated); faculty and graduate mentors, weekly workshops
description: Two-year research fellowship that prepares students for PhD programs and culminates in a senior thesis; applicants must also apply to at least one summer research program. Applications open in December; priority deadline Feb 26, 2027.

title: Berkeley Physics Undergraduate Research Scholars (BPURS) - Spring 2027
eligibility: Physics majors doing research with a sponsoring Physics Department professor
benefit: $500 stipend after presenting at the spring Undergraduate Poster Session ($1,000 if in both fall and spring)
description: Department stipend for physics majors already working with Physics faculty; student and sponsor submit an application with a proposed deliverable. Spring deadline is always the first Friday in February (Feb 5, 2027); applications go out on the Physics major listserv.

title: BCNM Undergraduate Research Fellowship
eligibility: UC Berkeley undergraduates researching new media; priority to students in the New Media DE and certificate programs
benefit: $1,000 for approximately 50 hours of work; automatic acceptance to present at the BCNM Undergraduate Research Symposium
description: Assist a new media graduate student with dissertation-level research during the summer term. The undergraduate call opens by the start of spring semester with a deadline of March 1.

title: Economics Undergraduate Research Assistantship Program (E-URAP) - Spring 2027
eligibility: Any Berkeley undergraduate, with a focus on declared and intended Economics majors; prerequisites vary by project
benefit: Econ 199 units (P/NP), up to 3 units per semester; unpaid
description: Work as an RA on active research projects of Economics faculty and graduate students. The spring call for applications is typically posted on the Economics Major EdStem portal on the second Monday in January (Jan 11, 2027); deadline TBA.

title: Swan Award for Undergraduate Research (Psychology)
eligibility: Undergraduates proposing research in the Psychology Department
benefit: Research budget of up to $500
description: Annual competition funding undergraduate research proposals in Psychology, reviewed by the faculty Undergraduate Awards Committee. Due Friday Oct 30, 2026 at 4pm PT; late applications not accepted.

title: UC LEADS research program - 2027 cohort
eligibility: Registered UC Berkeley students with at least one semester completed at Berkeley; sophomore and junior STEM majors interested in STEM graduate school
benefit: Paid summer research internship at UC Berkeley, often a second summer of paid research at another site
description: Two-year program (one year for transfers) preparing students for STEM PhDs through mentored summer research and graduate school preparation. 2027 cohort application opens January 2027; deadline TBA.

title: CAMP Scholars undergraduate pre-PhD research program - 2027 cohort
eligibility: Registered full-time UC Berkeley students in good standing; second-year through senior STEM majors interested in STEM graduate school; UC Berkeley GPA 2.70+
benefit: Research and professional development support, including professional development grants (amounts not stated)
description: UC-systemwide CAMP alliance program supporting STEM undergraduates in research, with a February research symposium. 2027 cohort application will be released in January 2027; deadline TBA.

title: Churchill Scholarship (Berkeley campus nomination)
host: Winston Churchill Foundation / UC Berkeley OURS
eligibility: U.S. citizen seniors or recent graduates (within 12 months) in science, engineering or mathematics; bachelor's degree before October 2027; recipients usually have GPA 3.7+; must also apply for admission to Cambridge by the same date.
benefit: Full university and college tuition at Cambridge plus living and travel allowances for one year of master's study
description: Berkeley's campus deadline (and Cambridge admission application) is Oct 13, 2026, 4:00 p.m. PT; the Foundation's nomination deadline is Nov 2, 2026, 5 p.m. ET. For graduating seniors heading to grad school.

title: Michel David-Weill Scholarship — Sciences Po (Berkeley campus deadline)
host: Michel David-Weill Foundation / UC Berkeley OURS
eligibility: U.S. citizens (dual citizens not eligible); current undergraduate seniors at an eligible Sciences Po partner institution; GPA 3.7+; aged 19–25; accepted to an eligible Sciences Po master's program.
benefit: $80,000 covering tuition and living expenses for a two-year master's at Sciences Po, Paris
description: Berkeley campus application (Google form + advising appointment) is due noon, Nov 2, 2026. For graduating seniors entering a master's program.

title: Yenching Scholars — Peking University (Berkeley campus deadline)
host: Yenching Academy of Peking University / UC Berkeley OURS
eligibility: Bachelor's degree by Aug 31, 2027; preferably 25 or younger on Aug 31, 2027; English proficiency; PRC passport-holders with a U.S. undergraduate degree are not eligible. Open to international students otherwise.
benefit: Full fellowship for the Yenching Academy master's program in China Studies
description: Berkeley's campus deadline for the 2027–28 cohort is noon PT, Nov 23, 2026 (advising appointment required); the Academy's own deadline for the September 2027 intake is Nov 30, 2026.

title: Barry Goldwater Scholarship (Berkeley campus nomination)
eligibility: Full-time sophomores or juniors; U.S. citizens, nationals or permanent residents; college GPA of at least 3.0; intending a research career in natural sciences, mathematics or engineering. Requires Berkeley campus nomination.
benefit: $7,500 per year for educational expenses
description: Berkeley's internal campus deadline is noon, Dec 7, 2026 (students first complete the OURS interest form and meet the campus rep). The Foundation's national nomination deadline is the last Friday in January, which only nominated students submit to.

title: James C. Gaither Junior Fellows Program (Berkeley campus nomination)
host: Carnegie Endowment for International Peace / UC Berkeley OURS
eligibility: Graduating seniors or those who graduated during the past academic year (not if graduate study has begun); U.S. citizens or students who attended a U.S. university and can work in the U.S. Sept–June. Berkeley may nominate up to two students.
benefit: One-year, full-time paid research assistant position with Carnegie senior scholars
description: Berkeley's campus application (instructions, form, two recommendation letters) is due noon, Dec 9, 2026; about 15 fellowships are offered nationally.

title: Truman Scholarship (Berkeley campus nomination)
host: Harry S. Truman Scholarship Foundation / UC Berkeley OURS
eligibility: Full-time juniors (graduating between December 2027 and August 2028); U.S. citizens or nationals; committed to a career in public service. Requires Berkeley campus nomination.
benefit: Up to $30,000 toward a public service-related graduate degree, plus leadership programming
description: Berkeley's internal campus deadline is noon, Dec 14, 2026 (make an appointment with the campus rep for application access). The Foundation's national nomination deadline is Feb 2, 2027.
tags: undergraduate,public service,graduate school,campus nomination,national award,citizenship required

title: Boren Scholarship (Berkeley campus deadline)
host: National Security Education Program (NSEP) / UC Berkeley OURS
eligibility: U.S. citizen undergraduates, 18+, planning study abroad outside Western Europe, Canada, Australia or New Zealand in a region critical to U.S. national security; must be matriculated in a U.S. degree program.
benefit: Up to $25,000 for 25–52 weeks; $12,500 for 12–24 weeks; $8,000 for 8–11 weeks (STEM majors only)
description: Submit by Berkeley's campus deadline (noon, Jan 22, 2027) to receive the campus evaluation; the national Boren Scholarship deadline is Jan 27, 2027. Includes a federal service requirement.

title: Donald A. Strauss Public Service Scholarship (Berkeley campus deadline)
host: Donald A. Strauss Scholarship Foundation / UC Berkeley OURS
eligibility: Sophomores and juniors who have completed at least one year of college and will not graduate before June 2027; GPA in the upper third of the class; proposing a self-initiated public service project. Berkeley is a participating campus.
benefit: $15,000 ($7,000 scholarship + $8,000 project grant)
description: Berkeley's internal deadline is Feb 15, 2027; each campus committee forwards up to three applications in early March and awards are announced by mid-April.

title: Udall Undergraduate Scholarship (Berkeley campus nomination)
eligibility: Sophomores or juniors; U.S. citizens, nationals or permanent residents; either pursuing environment-related careers, or enrolled members of federally recognized tribes pursuing careers in health care or Tribal public policy. Requires Berkeley campus nomination.
benefit: $7,500 (Udall Foundation anticipates up to 65 awards in 2027)
description: Berkeley's internal campus deadline is noon, Feb 15, 2027 (advising appointment with the campus rep required). The national online application closes Mar 4, 2027, 11:59 p.m. MST.
tags: undergraduate,environment,Native American,tribal policy,health care,campus nomination,national award

title: Judith Lee Stronach Baccalaureate Prize
host: UC Berkeley Office of Undergraduate Research & Scholarships
eligibility: Berkeley students in any major receiving an undergraduate degree in Fall 2026, Spring 2027 or Summer 2027; international students eligible.
benefit: Up to $25,000 for a post-graduation project
description: Funds a year-after-graduation project that contributes to the public good and social consciousness; all materials (proposal, budget, transcripts, work sample, letters) are due Mar 1, 2027.
source_label: UC Berkeley Office of Undergraduate Research & Scholarships

title: Big Ideas Contest 2026-27
host: Big Ideas Contest (Blum Center, UC Berkeley)
eligibility: Currently matriculated UC Berkeley students meeting the contest's eligibility criteria; projects that already won a Big Ideas award cannot re-enter.
benefit: Awards from $5,000 to $20,000; finalists can win up to an additional $10,000 at the Grand Prize Pitch.
description: UC Berkeley's social-innovation contest. Pre-proposal round deadline is Wednesday, Dec 2, 2026 at 1 pm PT; selected teams continue to a full-proposal final round.

title: Collider Cup (Fall 2026)
eligibility: Top SCET student teams pitch. Startup Expo: at least one team member must have completed one SCET course by end of Spring 2026, and the project cannot be in a Fall 2026 course; current students and alumni eligible.
benefit: Collider Cup prizes to be announced; Startup Expo winner gets a 30-minute PearVC mentorship session and an Alchemist Accelerator interview, among other prizes.
description: SCET's semesterly startup pitch showcase at Jarvis Auditorium, Grimes Engineering Center, UC Berkeley, Friday Dec 11, 2026, 1-5 pm; At Large Bid vote at SCET Dec 9. Startup Expo application open now.

title: CITRIS Aviation Prize 2026-27
eligibility: Student teams from UC Berkeley, UC Davis, UC Merced or UC Santa Cruz; 2-8 students with at least one undergraduate and no more than three graduate students; adviser-signed approval form required.
benefit: CITRIS Aviation Excellence Award ($1,500), with more awards to be announced.
description: Two-phase UC engineering competition to build parts of a human-in-the-loop mission guidance system for the California Airlink eVTOL network. Phase 1 concept pitch (max 3-page PDF) due Nov 23, 2026 at 6 pm PT; Phase 2 runs Jan-May 2027 with final demos tentatively May 3; NASA Ames reps judge.
